prompts.arcade: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animated category mascot for PlayPile, a retro browser arcade. Generate ONE transparent sprite sheet containing SIX sequential full-body poses of the SAME ORIGINAL character, arranged in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows equal-cell grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No labels, borders, lines, text, logos, scenery or ground plane. Each complete character wholly inside its cell with generous transparent gutters; same scale, center and foot baseline in all six cells. Every cell must contain the entire person and every held item. True alpha transparency, no checkered backdrop. Style: richly shaded 1990s arcade beat-em-up pixel art, mature full-body proportions around 6 heads tall, crisp dark contours, hard-edged pixel clusters, limited but vibrant palette, detailed clothing and expressive poses. Match the craft and density of classic arcade fighter sprites, not smooth vector art, not chibi. Invent a new character, not an existing fighting-game character or a Pavement Punchers roster member. No white karate fighter, boxer in red trunks, red samurai, cowboy, chicken suit, robot, ninja or guitarist. Animation should loop gently at six frames; most motion in the described action, not whole-body size changes. Approximately 100 logical pixels tall when used in the UI. Character: an adult arcade enthusiast with dark brown skin, short high-top curls, a mustard varsity jacket with teal sleeves over a cream T-shirt, navy cuffed trousers and chunky orange sneakers. Relaxed three-quarter stance facing right. His left hand holds a small generic wired game controller at his hip. Six sequential poses show him flipping a gold arcade token with his right thumb: token in hand, thumb flick, token just above hand, token at peak near shoulder, token falling, catch. Warm grin, believable detailed pixel face. No cabinet; the website supplies it separately.
